name: smwpatches-bring-up-life-exchange-prompt-fixes
title: Bring Up Life Exchange Prompt Fixes
description:
This fixes two minor bugs related to bringing up the life exchange prompt:

- Pressing L/R setting $1B87 even in one player mode, despite no prompt appearing. This could potentially mess with resources that expect $1B87 to behave in a consistent way.

- Pressing L/R to bring up the prompt while freely scrolling around the main map. This freezes the arrow animation on whatever frame it's on.
